cands.name: Emily Gregory
cands.bio: Democrat incumbent. Won a March 2026 special election 51%-49%, flipping the seat. Public health professional with a Columbia MPH and Wake Forest degree; previously owned a fitness community for pregnant and postpartum women. Age 41.
cands.local_ties: Jupiter resident (DLCC description quoted by Florida Politics).

record.text: Sworn in April 2026 after defeating Jon Maples in the special election. In Oct 2025 she and the ACLU sued Gov. DeSantis over the delay in calling the special election (Wikipedia).

money_notes.text: As of late Aug 2026 she had $105,000 in her campaign account and about $104,000 left in her political committee; named a top-10 state legislative race by the DLCC, which lets donors give to listed candidates.

endorsements.text: 314 Action and Engage Y'all; earlier Run for Something.

cands.name: Jon Maples
cands.bio: Republican. Financial planner and Northwestern Mutual advisor; former Lake Clarke Shores Town Council member; former Palm Beach Atlantic basketball All-American. Lost the March 2026 special election to Emily Gregory by about 800 votes; won the Aug 18 primary.
cands.local_ties: Panama City native who came to Palm Beach County on a basketball scholarship; DOE filing county Palm Beach (Florida Politics).

record.text: Former Lake Clarke Shores Town Council member (local office); 2026 special election nominee for HD 87.

money_notes.text: As of Aug 28, 2026 he had spent $143,000 of $147,000 in his campaign account; his political committee had about $100,000 available.

endorsements.text: Florida Medical Association PAC; Florida Chamber of Commerce; Florida House Republican Campaign Committee; Speaker-designate Sam Garrison; Republican Party of Florida chair Evan Power; AIF.
